verdict.rationale: Jules explicitly generates a plan that can be reviewed and approved before any code changes are made, and API docs confirm sessions can require explicit plan approval before execution proceeds — directly matching the 'approve scope/contract before modification' story. However, this is framed as an optional workflow feature rather than an enforced engineering-lead governance control (no evidence of mandatory approval gates, audit trail, or org-level policy enforcement), and community feedback doesn't address this approval-gate reliability specifically. Missing for 10: evidence of enforced/mandatory approval (not just optional), lead/admin-level policy controls, and independent confirmation the approval step reliably blocks modification.
